title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Psalms 32: the blessing of forgiven sin, confessing to Yahweh, and the warning not to be like the horse or the mule.

questions.text: Besides being forgiven, what has happened to the sin of the blessed man in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 32:1 says, 'Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.'

questions.text: What is there none of in the spirit of the blessed man?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says the blessed man is the one 'in whose spirit there is no deceit.'

questions.text: What happened when the psalmist kept silence?
questions.explanation: Psalms 32:3 says, 'When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.'

questions.text: In what was the psalmist's strength sapped?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.'

questions.text: What did Yahweh do when the psalmist acknowledged his sin?
questions.explanation: Psalms 32:5 says, 'I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.'

answers.text: He forgave the iniquity of his sin
He sent him far away from his house
He gave him a long and peaceful life
He made him a king over many

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the great waters when they overflow?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.'

answers.text: They shall sweep away the wicked

questions.text: What does the psalmist call Yahweh at the start of verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 32:7 says, 'You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble.'

questions.text: With what will Yahweh surround the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, 'You will surround me with songs of deliverance.'

questions.text: Like which animals are the readers told not to be?
questions.explanation: Psalms 32:9 says, 'Don't be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding.'
Verse 10 says, 'Loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.'
